sights.n: Nintendo Museum (ニンテンドーミュージアム)
sights.w: Nintendo's own museum, opened 2 Oct 2024 in the former Uji Ogura plant where it made hanafuda cards and repaired consoles — 135 years from playing cards to Switch, with hands-on exhibits.
sights.anime: Nintendo (Mario, Zelda, Pokémon) — the company's only museum, in its Kyoto home turf.

sights.w: Nintendo's 1930s original head office (used until 1959), the 'Yamauchi Nintendo' plaques still on the façade, reopened April 2022 as a Tadao Ando-designed hotel; the exterior is viewable from the street.
sights.anime: Nintendo — the building where the playing-card firm Marufuku/Yamauchi Nintendo was run before video games.

sights.n: Demachi Masugata Shōtengai (出町桝形商店街)
sights.address: Kamigyō-ku, Kyoto (Demachi, just west of the Kamo River delta)
sights.w: A 164 m retro local arcade at the end of the old Saba Kaidō mackerel road, with the Demachi-za mini-theatre — the real model for the Usagiyama shopping street in Kyoto Animation's Tamako Market.
sights.anime: Tamako Market (Kyoto Animation, 2013) — model for Usagiyama Shōtengai; the arcade openly welcomes fans.
